title: PharmaShip: An Entity-Centric, Reading-Order–Supervised Benchmark for Chinese Pharmaceutical Shipping Documents

bias_targets.methodology: Decoupling semantic entity labeling from visual layout structure (entity-centric annotation) to measure and mitigate model overfitting to superficial spatial patterns and proximity-based heuristics, evaluated through cross-dataset F1 performance comparisons.

Benchmarking various pre-trained text-and-layout models (pixel-aware, geometry-aware, and reading-order-enhanced variants) to evaluate how different architectural priors (e.g., explicit geometric biases vs. sequence-level guidance) impact semantic entity recognition and relation extraction.
